classification: restructures without inventing/replacing financial values WITHIN <td> cells, but not metadata-only at the row level
what_changes: the fused header row is rebuilt from `_CELL_RE.findall` alone; text sitting in the `<tr>` OUTSIDE any `<td>` (here, 'STRAY Total $9,999.00' between two cells) is discarded entirely when the row is rebuilt, and the money token it carried is discarded with it
what_does_not_change: the value that DOES live inside a `<td>` (the fused header's own values move to the same column index; the already-clean second row is untouched)
semantics_note: the date/digit_run appeared/disappeared entries include the same classification-boundary artifact already documented for this function's other fixtures (a digit glued to 'DATE' with no word boundary is reclassified once relocated to its own cell); the money delta is the real finding -- $9,999.00 is genuinely destroyed because it was never inside a <td> at all
